scope: Read-only independent review of multirow cache-A generalization; no new numerical execution by reviewer.
invariants: ceil(M/DIM)<=bm forces exactly one M group beginning at zero; local row-tile indices equal cached global row-tile indices including partial M tails.
Cached A panel (a,ki) occupies [(a*kt+ki)*DIM, +(exact a_rows)); the maximal exclusive row is bounded by bm*kt*DIM.
Ordinary B starts at bm*kt*DIM. Separate and prefetched B starts at bank2 only after proving complete A reservation fits lower two banks. Prefetch B reserves each upper bank independently.
Both reuse_b branches pass the row-tile index into dynamic A address. Stationary B preload versus compute-accumulate opcode choices are unchanged.
K panels remain source-ascending. Bias initialization, first-accumulator overwrite/accumulate, exact M/N/K tail extents and store scale remain unchanged.
additional_recommended_gates: Bias enabled with reuse_b=False and bm greater than actual ceil(M/DIM).
Cached A plus prefetch_b with K tail crossing the paired loop and static drain, e.g. K65.
limitations: The existing dynamic-address dialect verifier checks declared bounds, not an independently inferred SSA range; review verified this generator constructs those bounds correctly.
Review is not a new hardware or numerical result and does not replace actual capsule gates.
